title: Worker report
description: Final message of a worker run (AGENT-WORKFLOW section 5). Passed to `codex exec --output-schema`. Every field is required so that an empty answer is explicit.

summary.description: At most five sentences: what changed and what the result is.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths that were created, modified or deleted.

commands.description: Acceptance commands that actually ran in this run, in order.

result.description: One line, for example '57 passed, 0 failed' or the first error line.

not_run.description: Required checks that did not run, each with the reason.

evidence_class.description: Highest class this run produced. A worker never reports live or acceptance evidence.

deviations.description: Anything done differently from the brief, with the reason.

scope_requests.description: Changes outside SCOPE that the task needs. They are requested here, not made.

review_focus.description: The hunks the lead should read, most important first. Empty only when nothing needs judgment.

disposition.description: State of the working tree at exit and the resume condition if the task is not DONE.
